fields.Name: MJ.BizApps.Orders.Progress.Supersede
fields.Description: Replace the latest posted progress observation on a percentage-of-completion line. Orders.RecordProgress writes a new observation that names the one it replaces, reverses the replaced observation's recognition (on its own date, or in the first later month with no posted batch when its month has one), and posts the new catch-up, booked no earlier than that reversal date. Nothing is edited; the replaced row stays Posted and immutable. Held by the Orders Revenue Supervisor role, on top of MJ.BizApps.Orders.Progress.Attest, which every attestation needs. Without this row, supersede is refused.
